title: Collective Founding copy says grandfathered pricing to January 1 and the founder badge for Collectives that start before December 1

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-20: say grandfathered pricing + founder badge for Collective Founding; then: Badge till December 1 for founders.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-20 (ADR-1813). PREMISE RE-TESTED: the founder badge grant (grantBetaFounding) cuts off at the beta_grace window, December 1, while the Collective $99 runs to January 1 (LIVE-995). Owner ruled the badge stays December 1. No behavior change: the shared note, pricing FAQ, funnel copy and two help articles now say grandfathered pricing to January 1 and the badge for Collectives that start before December 1, from FOUNDER_BADGE_ENDS_LABEL (pinned equal to BETA_ENDS_LABEL).

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const b=fs.readFileSync('lib/pricing/beta.ts','utf8');const miss=[];if(!b.includes('export const FOUNDER_BADGE_ENDS_LABEL'))miss.push('no badge date constant');if(!/FOUNDING_RATE_NOTE = [^\\n]*FOUNDER_BADGE_ENDS_LABEL/.test(b))miss.push('note lacks the badge date');if(!/Grandfathered/.test(b))miss.push('note lacks grandfathered');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-996: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
